caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with a reddish-brown hue, standing on four curved legs that end in ball-and-claw feet. The chest features three drawers on the upper section, with ornate greenish metal handles; the two outer drawers are rectangular, while the central drawer is square with intricate carved floral and foliate decorations. Beneath the drawers, there is additional wood carving along the lower edge of the chest. The legs and corners of the chest also display carved decorative motifs, and the overall style is detailed with fine, realistic shading and texture to mimic the appearance of polished wood. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or features.
title: Lowboy
